title: 第1515章 复活金蝉子西海龙王前来送马你不觉得蹊跷吗第1514章 寻求圣人的帮助都求到昆仑山了本座自有办法
slug: 洪荒截教大师兄收徒就能变强
lines: 如来佛祖站在鹰愁涧上空。
他脚下的水域已经比之前小了不少。
兴水珠被罗宣收走之后，那些被强行引来的水失去了支撑，渐渐退去，露出了原本的山涧轮廓。
但水还没有完全退干净，涧底还积着一层浑浊的泥水，水面上浮着枯枝烂叶，还有几片白色的鳞片，零零星星地漂在水面上，在午后微弱的阳光下泛着暗淡的光。
如来抬手，朝着水面虚虚一抓。
一条残躯被他从泥水里打捞了出来，随后剖开腹部取出一些未曾消化的残渣。
屈指一弹，一滴水珠从他指尖飞出。
那水珠只有一颗米粒大小，通体透明，落下去的速度不快不慢，碰到那团残渣的一瞬便渗了进去，像是一滴清水落入干涸的土里，无声无息。
残渣先是微微鼓了一下，像是有什么东西从内部在膨胀。
然后那些模糊的边缘开始变得清晰起来，原本散乱的碎肉像被一根看不见的线牵引着，一块一块地归拢，拼合，像是有人在把散落在各处的碎块慢慢拼回原处！
轮廓从模糊到分明，从残缺到完整。
从一团血肉模糊的残块，渐渐拉出了一个头部的形状，然后是肩膀，是躯干，是四肢。
一个被吃了好些天的和尚。
得以复生！
唐僧躺在半空中，闭着眼睛，胸口缓缓起伏了一下。
他的睫毛动了一下，然后眼睛缓缓睁开了。
他第一眼看到的是灰白色的天空，目光缓缓移动，看到了如来佛祖那张宽大的面容浮在上方，看到他头顶那一圈淡淡的金光。
他整个人从半空中落下来，脚落在地上的时候，地面是湿软的，泥水浸上了他的鞋底。
他站了好一会儿才稳住身形，像是从一场极深的睡眠中醒来，大脑还处于那种迷迷糊糊的状态中。
他的目光转了一圈，落在如来佛祖身上，然后像是一根断掉的线突然接通了，他猛地跪了下去，膝盖浸进泥水里。
“阿弥陀佛！
多谢佛祖救命之恩！”
他的声音有些发颤，带着劫后余生的庆幸和慌乱，额头抵在手上，嘴里念了好几遍阿弥陀佛。
如来佛祖没有立刻说话。
他低头看着唐僧，目光沉静，带着审视的意味，“金蝉子，你身为取经之人，须知真经难得，此去西天千里迢迢，途中凶险莫测，你能承受得住这般凶险么？”
他的声音不高，却有一种不容回避的重量，像是每一句话落下的时候，都在唐僧心里压了一下。
“若是你畏惧死亡，本座可免你回大唐做个富翁终老，也无需去冒险前往西天取经。”
唐僧跪在那里，双手合十，抬起头来。
他的神情已经比刚才平稳了许多，嘴唇抿了一下，又松开，目光定在如来佛祖身上，声音虽然还带着一点刚才的虚弱，但语气已经稳住了，“阿弥陀佛，弟子不惧危险，愿意前往西天取得真经，以此普度天下众生。”
他抬头看着如来佛祖的时候，眼底有一种难以掩饰的激动。
他这一生修行以来，从来没有见过真正的佛！
他读的经书上说佛是觉悟者，是圆满者，是超越生死轮回的存在。
他读了这么多年，跪了这么多年，念了这么多年，今天第一次亲眼看到了！
如来佛祖没有再说什么。
他点了点头：“既然如此，本座便在西天灵山等你。”
说完，他的身形渐渐淡去，像是阳光下的薄雾被风吹散了，消失在半空中。
content_en:
Tathagata Buddha stands above Yingchou Stream.
The water under his feet was much smaller than before.
After the Xingshui Pearl was taken away by Luo Xuan, the water that was forcibly drawn lost its support and gradually receded, revealing the original outline of the mountain stream.
But the water has not completely receded yet. There is still a layer of turbid muddy water at the bottom of the stream. There are dead branches and dead leaves floating on the water, and there are also a few white scales floating on the water sporadically, glowing dimly in the weak afternoon sunlight.
Tathagata raised his hand and made a vague grab at the water surface.
He fished out a broken body from the muddy water, then cut open its abdomen and took out some undigested remains.
With a flick of his finger, a drop of water flew out from his fingertips.
The drop of water was only the size of a grain of rice and was completely transparent. It fell neither too fast nor too slowly. The moment it touched the residue, it seeped in, like a drop of water falling into the dry soil, making no sound.
The residue bulged slightly at first, as if something was expanding from the inside.
Then those fuzzy edges began to become clearer, and the originally scattered pieces of meat seemed to be pulled by an invisible thread, gathering and piecing them together piece by piece, as if someone was slowly putting the scattered pieces back together!
The outline goes from blurry to clear, from incomplete to complete.
From a mass of bloody remains, the shape of a head was gradually pulled out, then shoulders, torso, and limbs.
A monk who was eaten for several days.
Be resurrected!
Tang Seng was lying in mid-air with his eyes closed and his chest rising and falling slowly.
His eyelashes fluttered, and then his eyes slowly opened.
The first thing he saw was the gray-white sky. His eyes moved slowly, and he saw the broad face of Tathagata Buddha floating above, and the faint golden light above his head.
He fell from mid-air, and when his feet landed on the ground, the ground was soft and muddy water soaked into the soles of his shoes.
He stood for a while before regaining his balance, as if he had woken up from a deep sleep, his brain still in a dazed state.
His eyes turned around and landed on Tathagata Buddha. Then, as if a broken thread was suddenly connected, he suddenly knelt down and his knees were immersed in the muddy water.
"Amitabha!
Thank you Lord Buddha for your life-saving grace! "
His voice was a little trembling, with a mixture of joy and panic for the rest of his life. He rested his forehead on his hands and recited Amitabha several times.
Tathagata Buddha did not speak immediately.
He looked down at Tang Monk, his eyes calm and scrutinizing, "Jin Chanzi, as a person who seeks scriptures, you must know that the scriptures are rare. It is a long way to the west and the journey is unpredictable. Can you withstand such dangers?"
His voice was not high, but it had an unavoidable weight, as if every word he said weighed on Tang Seng's heart.
"If you are afraid of death, I will save you from returning to the Tang Dynasty to be a rich man until your death, and you will not need to risk your life to go to the West to learn Buddhist scriptures."
Tang Monk knelt there, put his hands together and raised his head.
His expression was much calmer than before. He pursed his lips and then loosened them. His eyes were fixed on Tathagata Buddha. Although his voice was still a little weak, his tone was already stable, "Amitabha, my disciple is not afraid of danger and is willing to go to the Western Heaven to obtain the true scriptures so that all sentient beings in the world can be saved."
When he looked up at Tathagata Buddha, there was an excitement in his eyes that was difficult to conceal.
In his whole life of practice, he has never seen a real Buddha!
The scriptures he read said that Buddha is the enlightened one, the perfect one, and the existence that transcends the cycle of life and death.
He has been reading, kneeling, and reading for so many years, and today he saw it with his own eyes for the first time!
Tathagata Buddha said nothing more.
He nodded: "In that case, I will wait for you at Xitianling Mountain."
After saying that, his figure gradually faded away, like the mist under the sun being blown away by the wind and disappearing in mid-air.
